meaning: Author-predicted adversarial acceptance criteria for a future independently authorized examiner and actual D2 integration. Not executable unit tests, not proof, not consent.

cases.challenge: Construct an exact-class ReadIntent whose required principal_id_claim field is absent (for example a damaged/deserialized instance, without executing a test here). Re-read the direct field access before row append.
cases.desired_security_behavior: No exception escaping past attempt custody; explicit fail-closed custody-gap evidence and independently retained ingress witness, or a provably durable denial observation.
cases.static_finding: v0.7 uses exact-class equality then unguarded direct field reads; no missing-field exception handler is present.

cases.source_boundary: v0.3 historical replay + v0.4 A0 one-shot evidence
cases.challenge: Compose the original v0.3 commit sequence with the same v0.4 adapter on historical retry.
cases.desired_security_behavior: Repeat D attempts stay separately observed; past committed effect returned only in D-private reconciliation; no new effect and no renewed A0 commit proof.
cases.static_finding: v0.3 checks A0 evidence before historical effect lookup; v0.4 one-shot adapter rejects the second call.

cases.challenge: Crash or restart between receiving an external read request and persisting its D attempt, while the ingress witness retains the arrival.
cases.desired_security_behavior: Fail closed, no receipt disclosure, independent mismatch/gap reconciliation and verifiable monotonic attempt persistence.
cases.static_finding: v0.7 returns in-memory next journal only, not durable commit proof.

cases.source_boundary: Duplicate ingress attempts vs effect idempotency
cases.challenge: Send two bit-identical historical-read requests through distinct ingress deliveries and require separate attempt receipts, while no new effect is authorized.
cases.desired_security_behavior: At least two distinct D or independently witnessed attempts, no second effect, no mistaken hash-based attempt deduplication.
cases.static_finding: v0.7 RA02 models two in-memory rows; no durable effect/ingress integration.

cases.source_boundary: Historical A0 issuance-time key after retirement
cases.challenge: Use a genuinely old signed token issued before rotation but request a receipt with no currently authorized read grant.
cases.desired_security_behavior: Original issuance-time authenticity may be assessed under independent immutable archive; receipt read rejected without present requester grant; no new A0 admission.
cases.static_finding: v0.7 only logs attacker-supplied issuer-key claim and never authenticates source.

cases.source_boundary: Compromised historical key and untrusted time claims
cases.challenge: Present a historically valid signature from a key whose compromise epoch is uncertain and whose claimed issuance time is not independently anchored.
cases.desired_security_behavior: Hold for independent provenance adjudication; never infer unrevoked issuer, current effect rights or receipt-read authorization from signature alone.
cases.static_finding: No independent historical signer key archive or timestamp provenance service.

cases.source_boundary: A0 checkpoint rollback and receipt replay
cases.challenge: Restore a stale A0 snapshot while retaining a cached D challenge/proof that is internally consistent but older than an independent checkpoint.
cases.desired_security_behavior: External monotonic high-watermark rejects stale state at effect time, including failed rollback/recovery races.
cases.static_finding: v0.4 AP21/AP26 intentionally expose insufficient checkpoint freshness.

cases.source_boundary: Challenge nonce consumed across processes and restores
cases.challenge: Instantiate two proof adapters or restore D after a consumed nonce, then present the identical A0 proof.
cases.desired_security_behavior: Protected D-issued nonce can support at most one logically authorized consumption across crash, process restart and restore.
cases.static_finding: v0.4 AP25 shows separately instantiated adapters accept the same nonce in a synthetic model.

cases.source_boundary: Legacy direct D effect path bypass
cases.challenge: Inspect every possible effect-producing entrypoint and attempt to reach a raw v0.1/v0.2 or untrusted v0.3 callback path.
cases.desired_security_behavior: One D-protected source-pinned verified entrypoint with independent enforcement; no direct effect via old model APIs.
cases.static_finding: Historical raw effect functions are retained; no proof they are absent from a future deployed service.

cases.source_boundary: A0 STOP_PREPARED vs D STOP_FENCED partial ordering
cases.challenge: Induce D-first and A0-first stop orderings with admitted A0 reservations and concurrent D effects.
cases.desired_security_behavior: No false global STOP assertion; independently order/fence both authorities and account for transient admitted-but-not-executed reservations.
cases.static_finding: Reference model and architecture acknowledge no unified stop receipt; actual distributed serialization absent.

cases.source_boundary: External ingress absent from D ledger
cases.challenge: Terminate D or interrupt transport after an independent ingress witness observes an incoming historical-read request but before D sees it.
cases.desired_security_behavior: Independent arrival count vs D-attempt count reconciliation; no false claim that journal is complete; failure blocks disclosure.
cases.static_finding: A D-private source journal cannot witness arrivals that do not reach D.

cases.source_boundary: External receipt send versus ledger disclosure reservation
cases.challenge: Crash during an external historical receipt send, between irrevocable send reservation and client acknowledgment, then retry.
cases.desired_security_behavior: Bounded send policy with durable per-attempt release record and explicitly uncertain-delivery state; never claim end-to-end exactly-once output without transport witness.
cases.static_finding: Neither v0.6 nor v0.7 permits external release; no send adapter exists.

preconditions_for_any_real_test: distinct D1 examiner independent of the source author
frozen source commit and independently retrieved raw bytes/digests
explicitly named disposable off-host lab target with owner
separately controlled A0/D/C operators, backup keys, and rollback roots
read-only D2-S1 inventory consent before inspection
new target-scoped D3 execution consent before any runtime tests
independent custody of ingress, commit, send and recovery observations
no personal Mac, PS5, PSN, Remote Play, production or public network target
